criteria.label: Receipt and acceptance
criteria.expected_outcome: Delivery signature does not create usable stock.

checkpoints.outcome: Record two physical packages/one accepted unit and wrong-damaged quarantine with provenance.
Exclude wrong/damaged unit from available stock and two-unit readiness.
Preserve packaging/photos, exact wrong-model/condition, original PO and receipt evidence.
Assign procurement return authority/replacement/credit chase before five-working-day deadline.

criteria.label: Programme
criteria.expected_outcome: Failed supply changes the dependent mobilisation.

checkpoints.outcome: Notify project owner that tomorrow two-unit installation is not ready and decide reschedule/safe independent stage under authority.
Record affected labour/customer commitment, replacement date confidence and next review.

criteria.label: Invoice matching
criteria.expected_outcome: Disputed and undisputed amounts are differentiated.

checkpoints.outcome: Identify £2,000 correct unit and £100 agreed freight as evidenced potentially undisputed amounts, subject to confirmed delivery terms; wrong unit £2,000 and premium £150 remain disputed.
Do not pay full invoice from carrier signature or automatically withhold valid undisputed amount just to hide unmatched lines.

criteria.label: Cost and ownership
criteria.expected_outcome: The unresolved financial and operational actions remain visible.

checkpoints.outcome: Retain £2,150 disputed amount, expected credit/replacement and separate accepted cost allocation without treating credit as received.
Give finance/project/customer proportionate update with owner, due/review and invoice-payment decision route.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: If contract terms condition all freight on full correct delivery, mark £100 under reviewed uncertainty rather than force payment; fixture establishes agreed freight value but not that condition. A reviewed safe independent stage is acceptable.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Install or count the wrong/damaged unit as available, or certify two-unit readiness from signed packages.
Release full supplier invoice/extra freight solely from proof of delivery, or mark unreceived credit as cash recovery.

critical_failures.outcome: Install or count the wrong/damaged unit as available, or certify two-unit readiness from signed packages.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59
